# `catalog_job`

Area: **catalog** ([all tables](README.md))

TMF620 importJob/exportJob: synchronous, finished on insert; documents as data: URLs.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Server-generated identifier. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | Database insertion time; stable list ordering. |
| `kind` | `catalog_job_kind` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no |  | ImportJob or ExportJob; fixed, decides the resource path. |
| `status` | `catalog_job_status` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no |  | Succeeded or Failed (JobStateType); final when stored. |
| `content_type` | `text` | no |  | Format of the document: application/json only. |
| `path` | `text` | no |  | Root resource the job applies to: the TMF620 base path. |
| `query` | `text` | yes |  | Export scope: NULL for the whole catalog or productCatalog.id=<id>. |
| `url` | `text` | yes |  | The document as a data: URL (import: as received; export: as produced). |
| `error_log` | `text` | yes |  | Why the job failed, as text; set exactly when it failed. |
| `creation_date` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When the job was requested (application clock). |
| `completion_date` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When it finished; the same request, so equal or later. |

## Constraints

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `catalog_job_completed_after_created` | check | `CHECK ((completion_date >= creation_date))` |
| `catalog_job_failed_has_log` | check | `CHECK (((status = 'Failed'::catalog_job_status) = (error_log IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `catalog_job_query_on_export` | check | `CHECK (((kind = 'ExportJob'::catalog_job_kind) OR (query IS NULL)))` |
| `catalog_job_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
